description: The file is a Java source code for the ShoppingCartController class, responsible for managing shopping cart operations in a Spring MVC-based web application for an e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding items to the cart, displaying the cart, removing items, and updating item quantities, using AJAX and session management.

classes.name: ShoppingCartController
classes.description: Controller class handling shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating items, and displaying the shopping cart in an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: addShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to add an item to the shopping cart, creating or updating the cart in session and database.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Displays the current shopping cart page, retrieving cart data based on session or customer info.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Displays shopping cart by specific code, setting up model attributes and page information.

methods.name: removeShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart based on line item ID, updating session and possibly deleting the cart.

methods.name: updateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantities of multiple shopping cart items via AJAX.
